PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Moments and equilibrium? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Moments and equilibrium.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Moments and equilibrium.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Moments and equilibrium.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Moments and equilibrium.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Waves? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Waves.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Waves.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Waves.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Electronics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Electronics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Electronics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Electronics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Electronics.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pressure? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pressure.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pressure.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pressure.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pressure.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy, Work, Power and Machines? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy, Work, Power and Machines.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Physics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pressure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Mechanical Properties of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Temperature and Thermal Expansion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Moments and equilibrium and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Energy, Work, Power and Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
